title: GTA 6 Extended Look Revealed: Netflix Exclusivity and YouTube Release
description: The first look at GTA 6 gameplay has arrived via Netflix with a six-hour exclusivity window, followed by a YouTube release. Get all the details here.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The First Gameplay Look at GTA 6 Is Here

Years in the making, the gaming community's first substantial look at *GTA 6* gameplay has finally surfaced. According to gaming outlet Push Square, fresh details and images from Rockstar Games' highly anticipated title have just been made available.

However, accessing this new media requires navigating a specific initial rollout plan, as the content has debuted through a major subscription platform before hitting wider public channels.

## Netflix Exclusivity Window

For the very first hours of its release, the deep dive video—featuring 17 new things learned about the game—is tied to a streaming subscription service. Specifically, the video launched on **Netflix**.

Because the video is currently behind this subscription service's paywall, outlets like Push Square and other gaming sites are unable to host or stream the video directly on their platforms just yet. This initial period is governed by a **six-hour exclusivity window**.

## YouTube Release Schedule

Players who do not subscribe to Netflix will not have to wait long to see the footage. The comprehensive deep dive is scheduled to be uploaded to YouTube shortly after the exclusivity window concludes.

According to the announcement, the GTA 6 Extended Look will go live on YouTube at the following time:
- **Date & Time:** 9:00 PM EDT on August 27, 2026

Once this time arrives, the extensive look at *GTA 6* details and images will be fully accessible to the global public on YouTube.

## Editor's Take

Partnering with a subscription platform like Netflix for a brief exclusivity window is an interesting marketing strategy for GTA 6. While it creates a temporary barrier for some fans, the six-hour wait is relatively short. With 17 new details to dissect, this drop is guaranteed to fuel community discussions across YouTube and social media once the public floodgates open.
